verdict.rationale: CrewAI is described as an open-source framework with a public GitHub repo. It installs locally via `uv tool install crewai` and runs crews through its own CLI, so the managed AMP platform is an optional extension rather than a requirement. It also supports multiple LLM providers, and a community user built a crew that worked with tool-calling models, noting most local Ollama models struggled with tool calling. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on self-hosted production deployment (containers, serving, scaling), explicit confirmation that no vendor service or telemetry is required at runtime, and stronger evidence that fully local model setups work reliably.
